answer.summary: The change makes ObjectReaderImplList.instanceType == Arrays$ArrayList for CLASS_ARRAYS_LIST, which enables the dedicated Arrays.asList branch in readJSONBObject (line 429) but removes the ArrayList fast path used by createInstance(long)/createInstance(Collection) and therefore the non-JSONB readObject path (line 553); those now fall into reflective instantiation that cannot construct Arrays$ArrayList. Review createInstance(long)/readObject and the autoType tests (AutoTypeTest27.test_arrayList, DubboTest6.test1) plus text-JSON coverage of Arrays$ArrayList before applying.
